title: termctl shared definitions
description: Definitions referenced by every other termctl schema.

name.$comment: Lookaheads use [\s\S], not '.', so that U+2028 and U+2029 cannot hide text from ECMA-262 engines. The surrogate-pair alternative lets engines without the u flag accept characters outside the BMP while lone surrogates are rejected.
name.description: A name: 1-64 code points of valid Unicode text (no lone surrogates), no control characters, not containing '#['; displayed literally. Trusted input: callers never build it from third-party text.

display_name.description: The tmux window name as tmux reports it, read through tmux's format sanitizer (tab and newline become spaces). Untrusted: anything with access to the socket can rename a window.

marker_text.$comment: Lookaheads use [\s\S], not '.', so that U+2028 and U+2029 cannot hide text from ECMA-262 engines. The surrogate-pair alternative lets engines without the u flag accept characters outside the BMP while lone surrogates are rejected.
marker_text.description: 1-16 code points, the name rules, and not ending in '#'.

session_name.description: A session name termctl creates or targets (config, open --session, pre-open payload).

session.description: A session name as tmux reports it; any non-empty string (a user may have renamed the session). Untrusted: anything with access to the socket can rename a session.

duration.description: A non-negative integer without leading zeros followed by ms, s or m (bare: seconds); at most 10m.

socket_path.$comment: Lookaheads use [\s\S], not '.', so that U+2028 and U+2029 cannot hide text from ECMA-262 engines. The surrogate-pair alternative lets engines without the u flag accept characters outside the BMP while lone surrogates are rejected.
socket_path.description: Canonical absolute socket path: the realpath of the deepest existing ancestor of the parent directory, joined with the remaining components and the basename. Valid Unicode text with no control characters and no ','; not ending in ';' or '/'; a basename other than '.' and '..'. The limit is 100 bytes; maxLength counts code points and is an approximation.

socket.$comment: Lookaheads use [\s\S], not '.', so that U+2028 and U+2029 cannot hide text from ECMA-262 engines. The surrogate-pair alternative lets engines without the u flag accept characters outside the BMP while lone surrogates are rejected.
socket.description: A socket name (not '.' or '..') or an absolute socket path (the socket_path rules; '/' itself is rejected). The path limit is 100 bytes; maxLength counts code points and is an approximation.

decision_ids.description: The --decision-id values, followed by the decision ids returned by pre-hooks.

client.description: A tmux client name (its tty path).

signals.description: Signals termctl sends; SIGKILL only after SIGTERM. The kernel's SIGHUP on pane close is not listed.

placement.description: A configured placement; missing fields inherit from default.
